card.name: Random characters inside short URLs
card.fires_on: A single letter or digit in the middle of a random-looking code, mainly in shortened links (tinyurl, bit.ly, t.co) and YouTube IDs. Also seen in odd codes like PDB IDs and the end of a drug name.

card.plain: It fires on a stray letter or number inside a random-looking web link code.
